text:
Theresa (People Ops): Quick thread to do a final sanity check on review packets before we publish them tomorrow. A few small process clarifications so managers don't get surprised.
Lena (Eng Manager): thanks. main question: can teams run async calibration for APAC-heavy groups? timezone friction is real.
Theresa (People Ops): yes, async is allowed. Requirements: manager completes the standard rubric for each employee, adds a 1-2 sentence calibration rationale for any adjustments, and uploads an "async calibration summary" doc to the packet. People Ops will surface those during exec review.
Carlos (HRBP): For any promotion or comp-impact flags, what's the routing? I want to ensure comp ops sees them early.
Theresa (People Ops): Promotion/comp-impact flags must be marked in the packet and routed to Compensation Ops + the relevant VP. Include 2-3 pieces of supporting evidence (OKR snapshot, high-impact PR, customer note). We'll block-payroll changes without VP sign-off.
Priya: How should we handle partial-year hires and folks who joined mid-cycle? And contractors who converted recently?
Theresa (People Ops): Partial-year hires: evaluate on scope performed, include "% of period active" in the context blurb. Converted contractors: include in this cycle only if conversion/start date is on or before the cycle cutoff (03/25). Otherwise defer to next cycle unless exception form submitted.
Jon (Eng Manager): Reviewer conflicts: if the manager is out or conflict exists, can someone else submit on behalf of the manager?
Theresa (People Ops): Yes, designate a backup reviewer in Workday/packet. Backup must be L4+ and provide a short attestation: "I reviewed docs and endorse this assessment". Mark as "reviewer substitution" in the packet and notify People Ops.
Mike_SRE: Any quick checklist I can forward to ICs so their self-assessments hit the mark?
Theresa (People Ops): Paste this short checklist to share with ICs:
```
Self-assessment checklist:
- Top 3 accomplishments (1 line each)
- Biggest scope/impact metric (link if available)
- Areas for growth + examples
- Blockers or dependencies for next period
- Career intent (promotion readiness / IC vs. IC+ management)
```
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: manager reviews due 04/15 17:00 PST. Packet upload link: https://redwood.company/hr/review-packets
Carlos (HRBP): Thanks, Theresa 44d I'll push to my HRBPs and ask for backups to be confirmed by Friday.
Theresa (People Ops): Great thanks all. I'll publish the final packet template and one-pager this afternoon and send a follow-up thread with the async calibration upload steps.
